motivation: docs/research.md 'Live results and the 2026-09-14 stand-down': mom_ls was the entire live loss; the incumbent portfolio's own backtest trails SPY (13.46% vs 16.64% CAGR); the promotion gate never asked whether a portfolio beats the market. The user's goal is absolute paper returns that beat SPY before any real money.

benchmark.definition: SPY buy-and-hold total return from state/history/SPY.parquet (Tiingo adjusted close), zero cost, same rf as the candidate

windows.full: each candidate's data-limited start (stated per report) through 2026-08-12
windows.stress: backtest.windows.STRESS_WINDOWS where the candidate's instruments exist; reported, and judged only on the drawdown-within-band check
windows.frozen: 2026-08-13 onward is never read by any study in this campaign; it is reserved for the paper-validation protocol (Phase 4)

settings.elevated_cap: index/asset-ETF sleeves get {base: 0.80, 2x: 1.60} (mirrors risk.elevated_position_pct); single stocks never
settings.leveraged_etf_expense: embedded in the real ETF bars (SSO/QLD 2006+, UPRO 2009+, TQQQ 2010+); pre-inception synthetic series are labelled synthetic and used ONLY for stress-window drawdown, never for the judged cells

lev_trend.signal: index close[t-1] > 200-day SMA[t-1] (same iloc[-2] convention as engine.portfolio.trend_targets), evaluated daily
lev_trend.note: the vehicle is a leveraged ETF so the sleeve's dollar weight must respect leveraged_cap_pct; sleeve weight in mixes <= 0.20 at 1x

mom_long.signal: 12-1 momentum (close.shift(21)/close.shift(252)-1) on backtest.xsec_data.load()'s panel, price >= $5, 20d dollar volume >= $5M; long-only equal weight top-N

grid.rebalance_offsets: all 21 offsets, report mean and min/max across offsets
grid.rank_buffer: hold an incumbent until its rank exceeds 2N

mom_long.etf_alternative: MTUM buy-and-hold from 2013-04-18 (state/history/MTUM.parquet) as the same sleeve's ETF vehicle
mom_long.caveats: panel starts 2020-07-27, survivors-only; long-only positives are an upper bound; no crash-era evidence beyond the French proxy

haa.signal: Keller & Keuning (2022) Hybrid Asset Allocation, balanced variant: offensive SPY/IWM/EFA/EEM/VNQ/DBC/IEF/TLT, canary TIP, defensive best of BIL/IEF; momentum = mean of 1/3/6/12-month returns; if canary momentum > 0 hold the top-4 offensive by momentum (equal weight, any with momentum <= 0 goes to the defensive pick) else 100% defensive; monthly on the last trading day
haa.caveats: published 2022 -> post-publication decay filter: must hold up in heldout_2023_plus on its own

mixes.rule: at most these six, declared here; no others may be added after results are seen

baseline_only.note: the shipped portfolio is reported alongside for comparison; tsmom is not a candidate ingredient (user decision 2026-09-14)

mixes.vehicle_choice_inside_mixes: each mix is run with lev_trend on SPY/SSO and, separately, QQQ/QLD; 3x vehicles are reported standalone only (their 2009/2010 inception leaves no GFC evidence)
mixes.sleeve_variants_inside_mixes: mom_long uses top-20 (the offset-mean series); the top-10 and MTUM variants are reported standalone and as a sensitivity on M3 only

pass_rule.per_cell: backtest.promotion.passes_gate(objective_class='benchmark_beater') with max_dd_cost_pp = paired_drawdown_noise_pp(spy_returns, candidate_returns) computed on that cell
cells_required: early_2020_2022 (when the mix's earliest instrument allows the full window; otherwise the cell is reported as not_evaluable, not as a pass)
pass_rule.stress: GFC and COVID rows reported for every mix whose instruments exist there; a mix whose GFC max drawdown is worse than SPY's by more than the paired band is flagged 'fails_stress' and cannot be promoted regardless of the screen cells
pass_rule.profiles: judged at gross 1.0 (base). Gross 2.0 (2x lab) is reported; the lab runs the overlay-scaled version of whatever base adopts

selection_rule: among mixes passing every required cell and not flagged fails_stress, choose the highest heldout_2023_plus excess Sharpe; ties within 0.02 go to the lower full-sample max drawdown. If none pass, the campaign's decision is 'no_candidate_passed' and the portfolio stays as shipped on 2026-09-14
what_happens_next: the chosen mix goes to Phase 3 (engine sleeves + config) and Phase 4 (pre-registered 3-month paper validation with kill rules) — never straight to a config change
researcher_degrees_of_freedom_declared: grids above are fixed; any parameter not listed takes the value used by the corresponding production sleeve
the six mixes were chosen before any candidate sleeve was simulated
offset averaging is mandatory for the monthly momentum sleeve because the 2026-09-14 leg study showed single-path monthly numbers that looked like rebalance-date luck
